visual_review.identity: Olive/gray-green grass with larger irregular tan bare-earth openings and fewer prominent stone groups than meadow3. Original sparse grass/exposed-earth identity retained within approved meadow-base palette.
visual_review.style_review: Several broad dirt openings and sparse simple grass marks. Most green areas are quiet broad planes, but exposed soil contains many small stone-like facets and denser edge fragmentation than requested. Fine detail is bounded inside dirt patches rather than uniform across the whole ground.
visual_review.palette_caveat: Greener/brighter than the original yellow-olive/brown swatch because approved meadow-base palette leads. Bare earth is warmer tan. Exact original color matching is not claimed.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Larger stone accents around70-130 native pixels,7-13 at128 or14-27 at256. Dirt openings form a loose diagonal chain that can read as an unbound path, but remain material coloration without road geometry.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque catalog-only tone1 candidate;128/256 preview and actual scene acceptance pending. No natural seamlessness claim.
